newSeedReadme:
# Invoice exercise

Use Python 3 standard library only. Implement invoice.py, maintain unittest tests,
and update this README as requirements arrive. This is an isolated exercise.

The summarize API returns a Python dict. Its ungrouped result has exactly the
string keys count, subtotal, discount, tax and total. count is an integer; the
four money values are two-decimal strings. Later turns add grouped results.
